# ZenScail

> ZenScail is an AI-native email and calendar workspace. It reads your Gmail inbox and Google Calendar, then hands you one calm daily brief — what matters, what can wait, and what's already handled. It drafts replies in your voice, triages mail by priority, and runs your schedule through a natural-language agent. Free forever when you bring your own AI API key.

ZenScail connects to Gmail and Google Calendar (via Corsair) and layers AI on top to remove inbox and scheduling busywork. Core ideas: a priority inbox that surfaces only what's urgent, a once-a-day AI brief of your mail and meetings, instant AI reply drafts, and a chat agent that can compose email, create calendar events, and invite attendees from a single natural-language instruction.

## Key features

- **AI priority inbox**: every email is classified urgent / normal / low with a one-line reason; an "Urgent first" toggle floats what can't wait to the top.
- **Daily AI brief**: a once-a-day digest of inbox + calendar — headline, action items deep-linked to the source email, and the day's meetings.
- **AI reply chips & drafting**: one-tap, context-aware reply suggestions and full drafts written in your voice; never auto-sent.
- **Natural-language agent**: chat or a quick-add bar that creates events, composes and sends mail, and resolves relative dates ("next Thursday at 9").
- **Smart inbox bundles**: the flat inbox splits into Important, Newsletters, Social, Notifications, and Everything else, with batch actions.
- **Snooze, Send Later, Undo Send**: move threads out of the inbox until later, schedule mail, and retract a just-sent email within a short window.
- **Follow-up reminders**: "remind me if no reply" resurfaces threads that went silent, with an AI-drafted nudge.
- **Scheduling links**: share a Calendly-style booking link from your real free/busy; guests pick a slot and the event lands on your calendar.
- **Keyboard-first triage**: shortcuts and a command palette (Ctrl/Cmd-K) to navigate, act, and search without leaving the keyboard.
- **Bring your own key**: use OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Groq with any model on the free tier; keys are encrypted at rest.

## Who it's for

People who live in Gmail and Google Calendar and want less inbox anxiety: founders, operators, freelancers, and busy professionals who need to triage high email volume quickly and protect focus time.

## Pricing

Free forever when you bring your own AI API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Groq). An optional built-in cloud AI tier is available as a paid subscription for users who prefer not to manage their own key.

## Notes

- ZenScail is a web application; the core mail, calendar, dashboard, and chat experiences live behind sign-in and are not part of the public crawlable surface.
- Built on Corsair for Gmail and Google Calendar access; all data access is OAuth-scoped per user.
